title: Molecular Heterogeneity of Aggressive Prostate Cancer: Insights from an Age- and Race-Matched Radical Prostatectomy Cohort.
snippet: Established molecular biomarkers, including ERG, PTEN, and SPINK1, have advanced the understanding of prostate cancer biology and molecular heterogeneity. However, whether differences in these biomarkers account for racial disparities in clinical outcomes or identify tumors with aggressive behavior remains uncertain.
